name: zero-slop
description: The Zero Slop skill, installable as a Claude Code plugin.

plugins.name: zero-slop
plugins.description: Zero Slop is a skill for Claude Code, not an AI model. Claude reads and edits in context; Zero Slop provides a before-and-after writing score, 267 phrase patterns, fact protection, guidance for separate copy-editing and read-aloud passes, and private learning from writer edits. The local checks run offline and have zero dependencies.
